answer: An AI-agent market handling sable shipments from an inlet to the tundra requires each seller identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before accepting work. A thousand fake sellers thus tie up $100,000, and dividing one wallet creates no additional bonded slots. Fraud proven by a verifiable execution trace burns the offending seller's bond, so abandoning identities and returning under new names requires fresh capital rather than free account creation.
